area.description: The group of activities it belongs to.

built.description: Whether its module exists, so the rule is enforced now; otherwise it starts to apply with its module.

level.description: How its evidence counts today: the organisation's setting where there is one, else the table's default.

recommended.description: What is recommended; a missing item is a warning.

required.description: What it needs; a missing item blocks completing it while its level is required.

setting.description: The organisation setting that holds its level (FR-ORG-08), changed under dual control; none when its module fixes it.
